additional_info.subject: ID0471335-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S3 170003314] Chargers Offline CRM:03288000090
additional_info.body:
Dear Giuseppe,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your request and after checking the charger, we see that the charger is online and stable.
Could you please clarify if there is any issue with the charger, as there are no error flags showing.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

Hi Priscilla good afternoon,
we don't opened a ticket related to an error of connection. Our issue was plugs not available.
In this moment on many of those chargers the error isn't visibile because on Wednesday 07/01 we rebooted all.
We need a check of the paste logs to catch the cause of this unavaiability.
Thanks in advance,
Giuseppe

additional_info.subject: ID0471335-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S3 170003314] Chargers Offline CRM:03288000090
additional_info.body:
Dear Giuseppe,
Thank you for the clarification regarding the issue.
Could you please provide us with a timestamp of when the issue occurred, so we can deepdive in the logs?
For us to understand the rootcause of a problem, it is the best if an error is still live, before rebooting the charger.
We will do our best to find the cause of the plug failure.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum
